About the Extension

AI Web Filter is a powerful browser extension that uses artificial intelligence to filter inappropriate web content in real-time. It's designed to protect users from NSFW, violent, and suicidal content while browsing the web.

NSFW Content Filter

Automatically detects and blocks explicit content

Violence Filter

Protects against violent imagery and text

Suicide Prevention

Identifies and blocks harmful self-harm content

Educational Mode

Allows educational content even when sensitive

Note: This extension works offline and performs AI analysis directly in your browser. Your browsing data is never sent to external servers, ensuring your privacy.

Installation Instructions

Chrome

  1. Download the extension package using the button above
  2. Extract the .tar.gz file to a folder on your computer
  3. Open Chrome and navigate to chrome://extensions
  4. Enable "Developer mode" using the toggle in the top-right corner
  5. Click "Load unpacked" and select the extracted folder
  6. The extension is now installed and ready to use

Firefox

  1. Download the extension package using the button above
  2. Extract the .tar.gz file to a folder on your computer
  3. Open Firefox and navigate to about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox
  4. Click "Load Temporary Add-on..."
  5. Navigate to the extracted folder and select the manifest.json file
  6. The extension is now installed temporarily (will be removed when Firefox is closed)

Edge

  1. Download the extension package using the button above
  2. Extract the .tar.gz file to a folder on your computer
  3. Open Edge and navigate to edge://extensions
  4. Enable "Developer mode" using the toggle in the bottom-left corner
  5. Click "Load unpacked" and select the extracted folder
  6. The extension is now installed and ready to use

Usage

After installation, the AI Web Filter icon will appear in your browser's toolbar. Click on it to access the settings panel where you can:

  • Enable/disable the extension
  • Configure specific filters (NSFW, Violence, Suicide)
  • Adjust filtering sensitivity
  • Enable educational mode
  • Set an admin password to prevent unauthorized changes

The extension will automatically analyze web content as you browse and block inappropriate material according to your settings.
